name: surveyor_w_walk_v01
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: hand-painted NONPIXEL miniature NPC four-frame animation. Input image is the EXACT canonical single neutral model, not a suggestion. Keep the same compact 2.7-head proportions and SAME skull size, face angle, crown, shoulders, torso, pelvis and costume. Chestnut-brown chin-length bob hair, green eyes, small white daisy-and-leaf ornament on her anatomical LEFT temple, human round ears. Olive-green short hooded travel cape with hood DOWN behind bare head, pale gold botanical trim, ivory puff-sleeve blouse and layered short ivory skirt, brown fitted lace-up waist corset and leather belt, opaque dark-brown tights, brown mid-calf lace-up boots with small leaves. ONE brown field satchel on anatomical RIGHT hip and a closed brown embossed leaf field notebook held low by LEFT hand, right hand relaxed. Preserve her botanical researcher silhouette and muted olive/ivory/brown palette from portrait. Do not turn cape into a raised hood or give her an archer bow. Camera locked to strict LEFT PROFILE, looking screen-left; never turn head/body. Draw one slow in-place WALK CYCLE, four DISTINCT chronological poses in 2x2 reading order. Frame1 foreground anatomical LEFT leg reaches LEFT heel contact, background RIGHT leg trails RIGHT. Frame2 LEFT straight supports under pelvis, RIGHT knee swings forward. Frame3 foreground LEFT thigh/shin slope to screen-RIGHT with raised heel, background RIGHT leg extends LEFT heel contact. Frame4 RIGHT supports under pelvis, foreground LEFT knee bends and swings forward. Bottom row must put foreground leg at BACK/RIGHT, opposite top row. Keep upper body upright, pelvis height and leg/boot lengths constant. Hands/props retain original low carrying position, no extra hand. Small cloth/ponytail sway only. Lower legs must visibly exchange front/back ownership; DO NOT repeat same leading leg in frame3. Composition: four separate COMPLETE full-body figures in equal2x2 cells. Each figure occupies ONLY 70% of cell height with 15% EMPTY TRANSPARENT border ABOVE hair, BELOW soles, and around all props. Generous margin especially ponytail/ahoge. Each has exactly2 arms/2 hands/2 legs. No cut-off body edges or touching cells. Refined broad soft-painted shading exactly matching reference. True transparent RGBA background; no shadow/floor, letters/numbers/gridlines, particles, props not in model, camera change, growth/shrink, alternate costume, labels or backdrop. Preserve anatomical accessory sides.
